definitions.explanation: Describes accuracy or precision so remarkable that nothing can compare to it. A four-character compound (yojijukugo) combining 正確 (accurate) with 無比 (without equal).

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}のシュートは{正確無比|せいかくむひ}だ。
{正確無比|せいかくむひ}なパスで{得点|とくてん}チャンスを{作|つく}った。
examples.english: He created a scoring chance with a pinpoint-accurate pass.

examples.japanese: {職人|しょくにん}の{正確無比|せいかくむひ}な{技術|ぎじゅつ}によって、{一|ひと}つひとつの{部品|ぶひん}が{完璧|かんぺき}に{仕上|しあ}げられる。
examples.english: Thanks to the craftsman's unparalleled precision, each part is finished to perfection.

notes:
USAGE:
A {四字熟語|よじじゅくご} (four-character compound) often used in sports commentary and praise of skilled craftsmanship. The suffix {無比|むひ} (without equal) can combine with other words: {勇気|ゆうき}{無比|むひ} (unmatched courage), {豪華|ごうか}{無比|むひ} (unparalleled splendor).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正確無比|せいかくむひ}なシュート (a pinpoint-accurate shot)
- {正確無比|せいかくむひ}な{技術|ぎじゅつ} (unrivaled technique)
- {正確無比|せいかくむひ}な{制御|せいぎょ} (incomparably precise control)
